chemistry: Solution-phase chemistry, including 120 nucleophilic aromatic substitutions in six phases.
data_regime: 1.4 million solvation energies and forces from DFT and SMD in 36 solvents, with charged, open-shell and transition-state structures.
validation: Reproduces DFT-SMD solvation energies to 2-4 meV MAE on external benchmarks and matches DFT-SMD against experimental solvation free energies.

label: Systematic softening in universal MLIPs
full_title: Systematic softening in universal machine learning interatomic potentials
chemistry: Materials, including surfaces, defects, solid solutions, ion migration and phonons.
data_regime: Atomic-modelling benchmarks on high-energy states. Sizes not stated in the abstract.
validation: Energy and force underprediction appears across the benchmarks. No separate validation is stated in the abstract.

label: UMA: Universal Models for Atoms
full_title: UMA: A Family of Universal Models for Atoms
chemistry: Molecules, materials and catalysts.
data_regime: Half a billion unique 3D atomic structures compiled across chemical domains.
validation: Evaluated on applications across domains, with held-out test splits including OMol25 out-of-distribution sets. A single model without fine-tuning is reported to perform similarly to or better than specialized models.

label: OMol25 data set, evaluations and models
full_title: The Open Molecules 2025 (OMol25) Dataset, Evaluations, and Models
chemistry: Small molecules, biomolecules, metal complexes and electrolytes across 83 elements.
data_regime: More than 100 million DFT calculations, about 83M unique molecular systems, up to 350 atoms.
validation: Baseline models and a set of evaluations are provided, including out-of-distribution test sets. The authors note limited coverage for lanthanide complexes, multimetallic structures and some solvated species.

label: MACE-POLAR-1 electrostatic foundation model
full_title: MACE-POLAR-1: A Polarisable Electrostatic Foundation Model for Molecular Chemistry
chemistry: Molecular chemistry, from small molecules to protein-ligand complexes and transition metal complexes.
data_regime: Trained on the OMol25 data set of 100 million hybrid DFT calculations.
validation: Benchmarks cover thermochemistry, barriers and conformers. On protein-ligand interactions, MAEs of 3.35-3.68 kcal/mol are reported against 29.9 kcal/mol for MACE-OMOL.

label: AIMNet2-rxn for general reaction modelling
full_title: AIMNet2-rxn: A machine-learned potential for generalized reaction modeling on a millions-of-pathways scale
chemistry: Closed-shell reactions of carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen and oxygen.
data_regime: About 4.7 million range-separated DFT calculations.
validation: 1 to 2 kcal/mol accuracy across reaction coordinates on a test suite of known mechanisms, without retraining. Test pathways were withheld from training.

label: UMA on transition-metal catalyst conformers
full_title: Performance of Meta’s Universal Model for Atoms across the Conformational and Configurational Space of Diverse Transition-Metal Catalysts
chemistry: Transition-metal complexes: Ni bisphosphine, Ru(II) and Mn(I).
data_regime: Two data sets. Data set 1 has conformers of square-planar Ni complexes with 25 bisphosphine ligands.
validation: Reliable rankings (ρ > 0.6, p < 0.05) for 84% of ligands in rigid Ni-Cl2 and 53% in flexible Ni complexes, and 61% for Ru(II) and 44% for Mn(I).

label: Benchmarks of pretrained ML potentials
full_title: Accuracy and Efficiency Benchmarks of Pretrained Machine Learning Potentials for Molecular Simulations
chemistry: Molecules and dimers from SPICE, plus water boxes.
data_regime: SPICE test set of 800 molecules and dimers with 10 conformations each.
validation: 15 models are compared on accuracy, speed, memory use and stability. Orb-v3-omol, UMA-m-1.1 and UMA-s-1.1 have MAE below 1 kcal/mol on every subset.

label: Universal MLIPs for noncovalent interactions
full_title: Benchmarking Universal Machine-learned Interatomic Potentials for Intermolecular and Noncovalent Interactions
chemistry: Hydrogen-bonded, dispersion, sigma-hole, ionic, charge transfer and repulsive interactions.
data_regime: Twenty-one data sets with references at or near CCSD(T)/CBS accuracy.
validation: Overlap between training and benchmark data was quantified. S12L and L7 show large errors for all models, driven by a few complexes.

label: OrbitAll: orbital-based molecular learning
full_title: OrbitAll: A Unified Quantum Mechanical Representation Deep Learning Framework for All Molecular Systems
chemistry: Charged, open-shell and solvated molecules, including solvent-dependent reaction pathways.
data_regime: Chemically diverse data sets, including a 400K QM9star training set and an OMol25 subset.
validation: Reported chemical accuracy with 10 times less data than competing models, and 10^3-10^4 speedup over DFT. Comparison with UMA covers highly charged species.

label: Model-free information theory for atomistic ML
full_title: Model-free estimation of completeness, uncertainties, and outliers in atomistic machine learning using information theory
chemistry: Atomistic simulations and training sets, including molecules and elemental metals.
data_regime: Data sets include rMD17, GAP-20 and TM23.
validation: Entropy measures are compared with MLIP force errors, and overlap between data sets is related to errors for models tested on warmer TM23 subsets.

label: Latent features of universal MLIPs compared
full_title: Comparing the Latent Features of Universal Machine‐Learning Interatomic Potentials
chemistry: Universal potentials across materials and molecules.
data_regime: Reconstruction errors on 1,000 atomic environments sampled from the MAD data set, with an Alexandria subset as a check.
validation: Global and local feature reconstruction errors are computed between models, tasks and fine-tuning strategies.

label: Distribution shifts for universal MLIPs
full_title: Understanding and mitigating distribution shifts for universal machine learning interatomic potentials
chemistry: Molecules and materials, including a SPICE to SPICEv2 shift.
data_regime: Foundation models tested on new SPICEv2 molecules, MD22 and other shift benchmarks.
validation: On the SPICEv2 shift benchmark, force MAE moves from 26.75 to 26.0 meV/Å for MACE-OFF and from 22.9 to 19.9 meV/Å for GemNet-T with refinement.

label: Kinetic simulation on gigantic reaction networks
full_title: Predicting Enantioselectivity via Kinetic Simulations on Gigantic Reaction Path Networks
chemistry: Asymmetric alkene hydroalkoxylation by an imidodiphosphorimidate catalyst, 228 atoms in total.
data_regime: System-specific NNP trained iteratively to DFT, with a network of 20,920 equilibrium structures and 48,463 paths.
validation: MAE of 1.2 kJ/mol against DFT on 418 EQs and 970 TSs. Computed S:R 99.95:0.05 against experimental 98.5:1.5.

label: NNP-AFIR reaction path search on Passerini
full_title: An Accurate and Efficient Reaction Path Search with Iteratively Trained Neural Network Potential: Answering the Passerini Mechanism Controversy
chemistry: The Passerini reaction with and without an extra acid molecule, on experimental substrates.
data_regime: Specialized NNP trained from less than about 0.1% of the DFT calculations otherwise needed. Networks hold 48,640 equilibrium states and 156,236 paths.
validation: About 1.7 kJ/mol MAE relative to DFT, excluding very high energy geometries.

label: UMA for enantioselectivity prediction
full_title: Universal Model for Atoms (UMA) in Computational Asymmetric Catalysis: Comparing Enantioselectivity Predictions
chemistry: Two organocatalytic and two metal-catalyzed transformations.
data_regime: Not stated in the abstract
validation: Experimental selectivity trends reproduced with accuracy within 1-2 kcal/mol.

label: SELECT50 and foundation MLIPs for selectivity
full_title: Accelerating Mechanistic Understanding and Prediction of Chemical Selectivity with Foundation Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
chemistry: Stereo-, chemo- and regioselective organic and organometallic reactions, with Ni and Pd reaction families.
data_regime: SELECT50, a collection of paired selectivity-determining transition states. Assemblies of up to 211 atoms were also treated.
validation: Relative TS energy MAE of 0.36 and 0.44 kcal/mol, reduced to 0.25 with DFT single points. Experimental tracking R2 0.87-0.90, ρ 0.80.

label: Reactive ML/MM for Diels-Alderases
full_title: Multiscale machine learning molecular mechanics for mechanism and stereoselectivity of Diels-Alderase catalysis
chemistry: Diels-Alderases (MaDA family), with activity, mutational effects and endo/exo preference.
data_regime: Universal reactive potentials that need no system-specific training, with nanosecond sampling of bond-forming reactions.
validation: Experimental activity and endo/exo preference reproduced with sub-kcal/mol accuracy. Mean unsigned error of 0.61 kcal/mol in ΔΔG across four MaDA-3 variants.

label: Cyclization selectivity with neural potentials
full_title: Anticipating the Selectivity of Intramolecular Cyclization Reaction Pathways with Neural Network Potentials
chemistry: Cyclizations with concerted bond changes, including intramolecular Diels-Alder reactions and natural product steps.
data_regime: Candidate pathways from graph-based enumeration on case-study reactions.
validation: AIMNet2-rxn barrier MAE of 2.9 kcal/mol against DFT, excluding two outliers. Stereoselectivity is checked against experiment, including a cis:trans ratio of 29:71.

label: Pitfalls of selectivity from TS ensembles
full_title: Overcoming the Pitfalls of Computing Reaction Selectivity from Ensembles of Transition States
chemistry: N-methylation of a tropane as a model reaction.
data_regime: TS ensembles of 86 and 146 structures, at ωB97XD DFT levels.
validation: Processing the same ensembles gave different outcomes, for example 98:2 from a single conformer and 5:95 from Boltzmann weighting of the 20 lowest structures.

label: Induced-fit model for Brønsted acid catalysis
full_title: An induced-fit model for asymmetric organocatalytic reactions: a case study of the activation of olefins via chiral Brønsted acid catalysts
chemistry: Asymmetric intramolecular hydroalkoxylation of terminal olefins with confined IDPi Brønsted acids.
data_regime: Transition state ensemble of 6,485 structures, reduced to 655 by DFT single points.
validation: Computed ΔΔG‡ of about 8 kcal/mol against the experimental 2.8 kcal/mol. Extrapolation to the basis set limit lowers it by about 1 kcal/mol.

label: DFT virtual screening of CPA allylboration
full_title: DFT Calculation-Assisted Virtual Screening to Refine Chiral Phosphoric Acid-Catalyzed Allylboration Enabling Organocatalytic Synthesis of Tetrafibricin C21–C40 Fragment
chemistry: Chiral phosphoric acid-catalyzed enantioselective allylboration of functionalized alkyl aldehydes.
data_regime: DFT transition state energy differences for SPINOL-derived CPA candidates.
validation: Experimental tests: candidate 11e(Me) gave 93% ee and 11e(H) gave 90% ee. The fragment route has 13 steps and 37% overall yield.

label: DeePEST-OS reactive potential
full_title: Reactive machine learning potential for accelerating transition state search in organic synthesis
chemistry: Organic reactions across ten elements, including Diels-Alder reactions and steps for complex pharmaceuticals.
data_regime: DORTS database of 74,837 reactions.
validation: On 1,000 reactions excluded from training: mean TS RMSD 0.12 Å and barrier MAE 0.60 kcal/mol. Diels-Alder diastereoselectivity gave R2 = 0.76 with measured values.

label: Automated TS searches with MLIPs
full_title: Reliable and Efficient Automated Transition-State Searches with Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
chemistry: Small organics, polymerization chemistry and transition-metal catalysis.
data_regime: 58 reactions with 24 algorithm-potential combinations.
validation: MACE-OMol25 reached 96.6% success on organics with an average of 3.8 DFT gradient evaluations. The freezing-string method reached 88-90% against 63-71% for the CI-NEB setup.

label: Generative TS models for unseen chemistry
full_title: Robust generative transition-state models for unseen chemistry
chemistry: Reactions from Transition1x extended with elemental substitutions and transition metal complexes.
data_regime: Extensions of Transition1x, including about 14,000 reactions in Transition1x-2p3p4p.
validation: On Transition1x-TMC, pretraining lowers median RMSD from 0.39 to 0.19.

label: GoFlow: flow matching for TS geometries
full_title: GoFlow: efficient transition state geometry prediction with flow matching and E(3)-equivariant neural networks
chemistry: Gas-phase reactions of H, C, N and O with up to seven heavy atoms.
data_regime: 11,926 reactions in the data set.
validation: D-MAE of 0.107 Å at 25 ODE steps against 0.164 Å for TsDiff. Random, reaction core and barrier height splits were examined.

label: FragmentFlow: TS generation for large molecules
full_title: FragmentFlow: Scalable Transition State Generation for Large Molecules
chemistry: Reactions with reactants of up to 33 heavy atoms.
data_regime: Training on Transition1x augmented with fragmented reactive cores. Evaluation on a new curated set of mono-, di- and tri-substituted reactions.
validation: About 90% of TSs identified within 1 kcal/mol of reference after Sella optimization, with 30% fewer steps than IDPP starts.

label: GOAT: global optimization for molecules
full_title: GOAT: A Global Optimization Algorithm for Molecules and Atomic Clusters
chemistry: Organic molecules, water clusters, metal complexes and metal nanoparticles.
data_regime: Not stated in the abstract
validation: Compared with methods such as CREST across various systems.

label: Conformer quality in learned representations
full_title: The impact of conformer quality on learned representations of molecular conformer ensembles
chemistry: Carboxylic acids, with Sterimol parameters of DFT-optimized conformer ensembles.
data_regime: Filtered data of 5,056 acids, split 4056/500/1000 for training, validation and test.
validation: Surrogate models are compared with computing properties directly from cheap ensembles, as a function of training set size and conformer quality.

label: MARCEL conformer ensemble benchmark
full_title: Learning Over Molecular Conformer Ensembles: Datasets and Benchmarks
chemistry: Drug-like molecules, organocatalysts and transition-metal catalysts.
data_regime: Four data sets with nine regression tasks, including Drugs-75K with 75,099 molecules and Kraken with 1,552.
validation: Representative 1D, 2D and 3D models are compared, with two strategies that use conformer ensembles.

label: Single-point Hessians for RRHO thermodynamics
full_title: Single-Point Hessian Calculations for Improved Vibrational Frequencies and Rigid-Rotor-Harmonic-Oscillator Thermodynamics
chemistry: General molecular systems, including reaction paths, crambin snapshots, supramolecular association, organic dimers and transition-metal complexes.
data_regime: Not stated in the abstract
validation: Tested against high-level DFT values. On average, DFT reference free energies are better reproduced than by conventional calculations on freely optimized geometries or without relaxation.

label: Enantioselective desymmetrization of azetidines
full_title: Catalytic Enantioselective Intermolecular Desymmetrization of Azetidines
chemistry: Catalytic asymmetric intermolecular desymmetrization of azetidines with thiol nucleophiles.
data_regime: Experimental substrate scope. No modelling data set.
validation: Kinetic studies and DFT calculations. The chosen protecting group gave 95% yield and 88% ee in optimization, and an all-carbon quaternary stereocenter formed in 97% ee.

label: Origins of selectivity in CPA azetidine opening
full_title: Identifying the true origins of selectivity in chiral phosphoric acid catalyzed N -acyl-azetidine desymmetrizations
chemistry: BINOL-derived phosphoric acid-catalyzed desymmetrization of N-acyl azetidines with 2-mercaptobenzothiazole.
data_regime: DFT transition states: 19 unique pro-(S) and 45 unique pro-(R) conformers.
validation: A free energy difference of 2.0 kcal/mol reproduces the measured 88% e.e. at 80 °C.

label: Selecting BINOL phosphoric acid catalysts
full_title: Selecting Chiral BINOL‐Derived Phosphoric Acid Catalysts: General Model To Identify Steric Features Essential for Enantioselectivity
chemistry: BINOL-derived phosphoric acids in nucleophilic additions to imines.
data_regime: Seventy-seven papers with over 1000 transformations.
validation: The analysis was verified with ONIOM calculations, and the model is reported as consistent with all the surveyed reactions.

label: Holistic prediction of enantioselectivity
full_title: Holistic prediction of enantioselectivity in asymmetric catalysis
chemistry: BINOL-derived chiral phosphoric acids in nucleophilic additions to imines.
data_regime: Published enantioselectivity data sets. The comprehensive regression model has 367 entries.
validation: R2 of 0.88 on the training set, with leave-one-out, k-fold, 50:50 external and leave-one-reaction-out analyses. Out-of-sample tests include a Z-imine prediction with average absolute error of 0.30 kcal/mol.

label: Predicting higher-selectivity catalysts
full_title: Prediction of higher-selectivity catalysts by computer-driven workflow and machine learning
chemistry: Chiral phosphoric acid-catalyzed thiol addition to N-acylimines.
data_regime: 1075 experimental selectivity data points.
validation: Three external test sets gave MADs of 0.161, 0.211 and 0.236 kcal/mol. A second study trained only on reactions below 80% ee.

label: Data science for a new CPA class
full_title: Data science enables the development of a new class of chiral phosphoric acid catalysts
chemistry: Transfer hydrogenation of an 8-aminoquinoline, plus two additional transformations.
data_regime: 20 structurally diverse catalysts as the training set.
validation: A validation set of sulfonamide catalysts was predicted. Classification by one partial charge reached 0.93 accuracy across three data sets, and the best catalyst gave up to 95:5 er.

label: Buried volume for Brønsted acid selectivity
full_title: Stereoselective Generalizations over Diverse Sets of Chiral Acids Enabled by Buried Volume
chemistry: Brønsted acid organocatalysts across 54 literature reactions.
data_regime: 50+ data sets across nearly 200 distinct catalysts.
validation: 67% of univariate models are meaningful at >95% confidence, with average R2 0.57 and MAE 0.21 kcal/mol. A mean-value predictor gives average MAE 0.37 kcal/mol.

label: Complementarity for acid catalyst design
full_title: Abstracting Complementarity for the Design of Stereoselective Acid Catalysts
chemistry: Brønsted acid organocatalysts across diverse structural motifs and functional modes.
data_regime: Not stated in the abstract
validation: Experimental validation of new stereoselective solutions is reported. Numbers are not stated in the abstract.
